Test Case Title: Upload the text file "single.txt" (5 bytes) and check the status shows name, size and type.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Test Steps: 1. Create the file single.txt with the text hello. 2. Choose the file in the single upload input. 3. Click Upload Single File. 4. Read the status message.

Test Case Title: Upload three text files "file1.txt", "file2.txt" and "file3.txt" together and check all names are listed.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Test Steps: 1. Create the three files. 2. Choose all three files in the multiple upload input. 3. Click Upload Multiple Files. 4. Read the status message.
Test Data: file1.txt (1 byte), file2.txt (2 bytes), file3.txt (3 bytes)
Expected Result: The status starts with "Multiple files selected" and contains the three file names.

Test Case Title: Click Upload Single File without choosing a file and check a message is shown.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Test Steps: 1. Do not choose any file. 2. Click Upload Single File. 3. Read the status message.
Expected Result: A status message is shown (it is not empty).
